facts.text:
进入战场时，琉音初始拥有60点[好评]，初始暴击率超过50%时，每超过1%，冲击力提升2点，最多提升100点；
发动[强化特殊技：石头]后，下一次发动的[强化特殊技]变为[强化特殊技：剪刀]，持续8秒；
发动[强化特殊技：剪刀]后，下一次发动的[强化特殊技]变为[强化特殊技：布！]，持续8秒；
[强化特殊技：布！]命中敌人时，敌人获得[恶意投诉]效果，[恶意投诉]效果下敌人进入失衡状态后的失衡持续时间提升2秒，失衡易伤倍率提升30%，从失衡状态恢复前[恶意投诉]效果对同一目标最多触发一次，失衡持续时间提升效果与同类效果不可叠加，拥有[恶意投诉]效果的敌人失衡结束时[恶意投诉]效果结束；
处于接战状态下，琉音每秒积攒0.6点[好评]，发动[强化特殊技：石头]、[强化特殊技：剪刀]、[强化特殊技：布！]的重击命中敌人时将积攒7.5点[好评]，同一招式内最多积攒一次，最多积攒120点；
当[好评]满90点且琉音利用[连携技：迎宾踏垫]、[强化特殊技：送客！]、[快速支援：呼叫转移]打开[连携技]窗口时，下一位出场的角色会将此次[连携技]强制升级为[终结技]，队友以此方式发动[终结技]时，琉音消耗60点[好评]；
当[好评]满90点且琉音发动[强化特殊技：送客！]命中未打开[连携技]窗口的敌人时，将消耗90点[好评]强制打开[连携技]窗口，下一位出场的角色会将此次[连携技]强制升级为[终结技]；
每当[好评]积攒至90点或发动[终结技]时，琉音获得1点[客诉]，最多拥有1点[客诉]。
facts.textEn:
Upon entering the battlefield, Dialyn starts with 60 Positive Reviews. If her initial CRIT Rate surpasses 50%, her Impact increases by 2 for each additional 1%, up to a maximum increase of 100.
After using EX Special Attack: Rock, the next EX Special Attack becomes EX Special Attack: Scissors for 8s.
After using EX Special Attack: Scissors, the next EX Special Attack becomes EX Special Attack: Paper! for 8s.
When EX Special Attack: Paper! hits an enemy, it applies the Malicious Complaint effect. While under Malicious Complaint, if the enemy becomes Stunned, the Stun duration is extended by 2s, and Stun DMG Multiplier increases by 30%. Before recovering from Stun, Malicious Complaint can trigger on the same target only once. The Stun duration bonus does not stack with similar effects. When an enemy with Malicious Complaint recovers from being Stunned, the effect ends.
While in combat, Dialyn gains 0.6 Positive Reviews per second. When a heavy attack of EX Special Attack: Rock, EX Special Attack: Scissors, or EX Special Attack: Paper! hits enemies, she gains 7.5 Positive Reviews. Each use of a skill can grant this bonus only once, up to a maximum of 120.
With at least 90 Positive Reviews, when Dialyn triggers the Chain Attack window using Chain Attack: Welcome Mat, EX Special Attack: Get Lost!, or Quick Assist: Forward Call, the next character to switch in will have their Chain Attack upgraded to an Ultimate. When an ally launches an Ultimate this way, Dialyn consumes 60 Positive Reviews.
With at least 90 Positive Reviews, when Dialyn hits an enemy with EX Special Attack: Get Lost! and doesn't trigger a Chain Attack window, she consumes 90 Positive Reviews to forcibly trigger a Chain Attack window. The next character to switch in will have their Chain Attack upgraded to an Ultimate.
Each time Positive Reviews reaches 90 or an Ultimate is activated, Dialyn obtains 1 Customer Complaint. A maximum of 1 Customer Complaint can be held at a time.

input.zh: 琉音在场，当前没有剪刀／布的替换状态时点按强化特殊技。
input.en: With Dialyn active and no Scissors/Paper replacement active, tap EX Special.

trigger.zh: 能量至少25点；若已有剪刀或布替换提示，应继续该段，不从石头重开。
trigger.en: At least 25 Energy. If Scissors or Paper is already the next action, continue that stage instead of restarting Rock.

complete.zh: 发动后，下一次强化特殊技替换为剪刀，窗口8秒；重击实际命中才额外积攒7.5好评。
complete.en: Activation changes the next EX to Scissors for 8s; its heavy hit must connect to gain the extra 7.5 Positive Reviews.

fallback.zh: 能量不足时先普攻、闪避反击或合法支援补资源；普通特殊技不等于石头，不推进三段。
fallback.en: If short on Energy, build resources with Basics, a valid Dodge Counter, or an actual assist. The normal Special is not Rock and does not advance the sequence.

reason.zh:
石头或剪刀后可点普攻接猜拳把戏，分别至多两段；这是可选补充动作，既不替代下一次强化特殊技，也不免除25点耗能。
初始60好评、上限120；接战中每秒0.6，三种强化重击各自每次招式最多加7.5。三段全中只直接增加22.5，不保证已满90。
核心F：恶意投诉使随后失衡延长2秒、失衡易伤倍率增加30%；同一目标恢复前最多触发一次，失衡结束移除，延时与同类不叠加。投诉本身不让敌人立刻失衡。
送客148100003的输入是持有客诉时长按普攻，消耗1客诉，并触发上一位角色快支；不是长按强化特殊技。达到90好评或发动本人终结技才获得1客诉，上限1。
好评至少90且琉音连携／送客／快支实际打开连携窗口时，下一位入场连携升级为终结技，队友使用后耗60好评；好评至少90且送客命中尚无连携窗口的敌人，则耗90强开窗口。强开窗口不等于敌人失衡。
升级终结技与普通连携动作不同，不能自动领取只由连携发动／命中触发的增益。只按实际提示选择角色，不把客诉快支和升级窗口视作两次免费入场。
reason.en:
After Rock or Scissors, Basic can add up to two Rock, Paper, Scissors strikes. This optional weave neither replaces the next EX nor removes its 25-Energy cost.
Positive Reviews start at 60 and cap at 120; combat adds 0.6/s, and each EX heavy hit adds 7.5 once per skill. Three successful heavies directly add only 22.5 and do not guarantee 90.
At core F, Malicious Complaint adds 2s to the following Stun and 30% to its multiplier. It triggers once per target until recovery and ends with that Stun; same-type extensions do not stack. Applying it does not itself Stun the enemy.
Get Lost! 148100003 uses hold Basic with a Complaint, consumes one, and triggers the previous character's Quick Assist. It is not hold EX. Reaching 90 Positive Reviews or using Dialyn's own Ultimate grants one Complaint, capped at one.
With at least 90 Reviews, if Dialyn's Chain, Get Lost!, or Quick Assist actually opens a Chain window, the next entrant's Chain upgrades to an Ultimate and costs 60 Reviews when used. With at least 90 Reviews, Get Lost! hitting an enemy without a Chain window instead spends 90 to force one. A forced Chain window is not Stun.
An upgraded Ultimate is distinct from a normal Chain and must not automatically receive Chain-only effects. Follow the actual prompt rather than treating its Quick Assist and upgraded window as two free entries.

input.zh: 石头发动后8秒内，再点按强化特殊技。
input.en: Tap EX again within the 8s replacement window after Rock.

trigger.zh: 剪刀替换仍有效，能量至少25点；石头命中并非替换的前提。
trigger.en: The Scissors replacement is still active and at least 25 Energy remains. Rock does not have to hit to establish the replacement.

complete.zh: 发动后，下一次强化特殊技替换为布，窗口8秒；重击命中才额外积攒7.5好评。
complete.en: Activation changes the next EX to Paper for 8s; its heavy hit must connect to gain the extra 7.5 Positive Reviews.

fallback.zh: 窗口内能补够能量才继续；窗口失效时按实际技能提示从当前段重新规划，不把普通特殊技记作剪刀。
fallback.en: Continue only if enough Energy can be recovered before expiry. If the replacement expires, follow the actual current skill indicator; do not count a normal Special as Scissors.
